data.title: The first issue of our magazine DIGITÁLNE HRADISKÁ is out!
data.excerpt: Dwarf Digital Archeology, in cooperation with the Hradiska.sk portal, presents the first issue of our magazine devoted to archaeology, hillforts, 3D visualisations and the scope for using modern technology in this field. Alongside our own articles it carries popular pieces by several specialists, some of which even contain information not published before.
data.metaTitle: The first issue of Digitálne Hradiská is out
data.metaDescription: The first issue of the Digitálne Hradiská magazine by Dwarf Digital and Hradiska.sk: archaeology, hillforts, 3D visualisations and modern technology.

mediaTexts.alt: The first issue of the digitálne Hradiská magazine on the theme of Celtic lowland settlements, on a wooden table

children.text: Dwarf Digital Archeology, in cooperation with the Hradiska.sk portal, comes with an unprecedented novelty – the first issue of our magazine devoted to the subject of archaeology, hillforts, 3D visualisations and the scope for using modern technology in this field. Besides our own articles we also approached several specialists with a request to write popularising articles, and we are very glad that a number of them responded positively to this opportunity and sent us good and valuable articles, which even contain information not published so far.

We trust that this pilot issue of our magazine will appeal to as many lovers of our history as possible, and that this will give us the strength and the appetite to carry on in this direction. If we see that the electronic magazine is a success, it will be appropriate to consider the possibility of publishing a printed version of it. Everything else that matters has already been written by Igor Bazovský, so I wish you pleasant reading.
